subject: Urgent: Arcadia Health throughput collapse — request for cross-region traffic steer & exec signoff
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@arcadia-health.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Production: severe latency and 5xxs in us-west-2

Vanessa —

We started seeing a sharp throughput drop and a spike of 5xx errors from our API calls to your US-WEST-2 endpoints at ~07:40 PDT. Latency has jumped from ~120ms p50 to ~1.2s p50 and error rate is ~8% for auth-protected requests. This is impacting our patient-facing workflows (checkout and results pages).

On-call attached a screenshot of the dashboard and a small request trace log. We paged your on-call and opened PD-8423 but haven't got a confirmable mitigation yet. Can you confirm whether this is an isolated AZ issue or a regional degradation? We need an ETA and a mitigation path — ideally a quick cross-region steer to US-EAST-1 and temporary ramp of capacity while you investigate.

Please loop in engineering and execs if needed. This is high-severity for us.

—Emma
Emma Lawson
Head of Platform, Arcadia Health

- Can infra confirm: AZ vs region? If AZ-only, can we evacuate traffic from the impacted AZ(s)?

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:32:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: severe latency and 5xxs in us-west-2

Vanessa / team — quick technical summary from SE triage:

Observations so far:
- Metrics show p95 latency increase and 5xx surge across multiple ASGs in us-west-2 starting 07:38 PDT; one AZ (us-west-2a) shows elevated CPU / queue depth on the serving pods.
- KV cache misses increased for long-run prompt workloads which amplifies load on the model runtime.
- No immediate signs of control-plane throttles; autoscaler is not scaling due to per-host limits being hit.

Immediate mitigation (30–60m window):
1) Traffic steer: shift 30–50% of Arcadia's traffic to us-east-1 using per-customer routing rules (can be done at the edge, requires TTL 60s).
2) Capacity: provision emergency burst capacity in us-east-1 (extra 6 GPU nodes) and enable higher batch sizes for Arcadia's model route to reduce token cost.
3) Cache warmup: pre-warm KV caches for the most common prefixes identified in their traces (we have the top 20 prompts).
4) Fallback model: in case of continued errors, fall back to a smaller quantized variant (quality regression expected ~2–3%).

Risks/notes:
- Steer will add cross-region latency for some requests; acceptable for Arcadia's async endpoints but not for low-latency patient UI calls. We should only steer non-interactive routes initially.
- We need Rishi to confirm capacity availability and finance signoff for emergency reservation.

I'll attach a one-page plan (proposed-geo-steer-plan.pdf) for ops to review.

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:00:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: severe latency and 5xxs in us-west-2

Thanks Grace — infra check results and ask for exec approval: 

Infra findings (09:00 PDT):
- Confirmed degraded performance centered on us-west-2a hosts due to a hot scheduling path and a simultaneous spike in long-sequence requests from Arcadia. Other AZs in us-west-2 show elevated load but are functional.
- We have capacity available in us-east-1 (approx 8 GPU nodes ready) but it will take ~12 minutes to warm and register with the serving mesh.
- Autoscaler limits for Arcadia's dedicated pool prevent quick horizontal scale in us-west-2 without an emergency commit.

Action request (needs exec signoff):
1) Emergency capacity commit: allow on-demand reservation of 8 GPUs in us-east-1 for 2 hours. Estimated cost impact: ~$6k/hr.
2) Approve traffic steer to move 40% of Arcadia's non-interactive traffic to us-east-1 with TTL 60s.
3) Approve temporary fallback to quantized model for the next 90 minutes if error rates don't drop below 1%.

If approved, infra will trigger capacity and we can coordinate a staged steer (10% -> 25% -> 40%) with health checks and automated rollback on error spike.

Please respond with explicit approval. Time is material here.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: severe latency and 5xxs in us-west-2

Approved. You have my signoff to proceed with the emergency capacity commit in us-east-1 and to execute the staged traffic steer as described. Key constraints: keep Arcadia's account-level spend capped to the estimate Rishi provided and notify me at each stage (10%, 25%, 40%).

Operational checklist before steer:
- Infra: confirm node registration and model warmup complete (attach latency heatmap).
- SE: provide Arcadia with the exact routing TTL and client-side guidance (disable client pinning for 15m).
- Customer success: send Arcadia a brief note explaining the mitigation and expected UX impact.

Vanessa, please loop Arcadia into a 3-way call (ops + Arcadia on-call) and include PD-8423 in the notes. Rishi/Grace — proceed and report back.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
